title: Page 142
transc:
Capt Sam Bruch  Washn Aug 4th 1864 430 PM 
Growl Aug Pension Katy For Paradise Frank Wal ford
Yours of yesterday received Zebra Before interfering with the
Judge Advocate Shelters order I should know his reasons
for making it zodiac Mean while if you have
not already started wait till you hear from me
again zodiac Did you receive letter & inclosures from 
me Star Walrus Ingnss warm & clear need rain


McCaine Monocacy  Washn Aug 5th 1864
Frank Aug Plaster Emily For Mutton
Keep me advised of your Tanners
& those torch Rome so that
Nabob may know where to go
to Swindle you yoke Jew Gentile


C. G. Sholes  Washn Aug 5th 1864 
Growl Aug Plaster Emily for Knapsack unity
Your request about Spartans from Gaul has
been anticipated Zebra Instead of Plank Promise
on hand they will not be able
to send you Plug Purple in less
than a week zodiac The country is
nearly exhausted of Panama and unless
there is a greater economy in their
use the spit must very soon go
a foot youth Italy whats matter van
